_comment: The in-app getting-started tour (/dashboard/tour). Every page route in src/app must be covered by a step's routes or listed in exempt with a reason; every step's shot must exist with callout notes. scripts/check-guide.mjs enforces this on every build. When you ship a new screen or change one, add or update its step here and bump 'updated'.

tracks.label: Getting started
tracks.audience: For everyone with a workspace: from signing up to every page in the dashboard.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.summary: Sign up with the email you'll pay with. You'll get a confirmation email straight away.

steps.title: Confirm your email and log in
steps.summary: The link in the confirmation email brings you here. Forgot your password? Reset it from the same page.

steps.title: Choose your plan
steps.summary: Pick Basic or Premium, monthly or yearly, and pay at the secure checkout. Your dashboard opens as soon as the payment arrives.

steps.title: Your overview
steps.summary: Your subscription, credentials that need attention, the next domain renewal and open change requests, all on one screen.

steps.title: The vault
steps.summary: Every key, token and login your apps depend on, encrypted, checked every night and sorted so problems come first.

steps.title: Add a credential
steps.summary: Paste the key once. UnyBase encrypts it, tracks its expiry and tests it every night.

steps.title: Reveal, copy and check a credential
steps.summary: Each credential shows its health, owner and expiry. Reveal or copy it when you need it; every reveal is logged.

steps.title: Share credentials with your developer
steps.summary: Give someone access to all your credentials or just one system, for as long as you choose. Revoke it in one click.

steps.title: Domains and renewals
steps.summary: Where each domain is registered, who owns the account, and when it and its SSL certificate renew.

steps.title: Add a domain
steps.summary: Record the registrar, the DNS login and the renewal dates. You're emailed 30, 14, 7 and 1 days before each one.

steps.title: Log change requests
steps.summary: Write down every edit you want made to your apps, one per line, and keep a dated record.

steps.title: Send changes and mark them done
steps.summary: Copy a batch for your developer in one click, then tick requests off as they're finished.

steps.title: Give a technical admin access
steps.summary: Let your developer or agency work in your workspace, with an end date if you want one. Revoke it any time.

steps.title: See what's new after an update
steps.summary: After an update that affects you, a short walkthrough of the changes opens the first time you log in. Every past update is on the What's new page.

tracks.label: Shared access
tracks.audience: For developers and contractors a client has shared credentials with.

steps.title: Log in with the email you were invited with
steps.summary: Sign up or log in with the address the client shared with. You don't need a plan of your own to see what they shared.

steps.title: Your shared vault
steps.summary: Only what the client shared appears, labelled with their email. Access ends on the date they set, or when they revoke it.

tracks.label: Technical admin
tracks.audience: For agencies and developers a client has granted technical-admin access.

steps.title: Your clients' workspaces
steps.summary: Once a client grants you access in their Settings, their credentials, domains and change requests appear in your own pages, labelled with their email.

steps.title: Your clients' subscriptions
steps.summary: Admin shows the payment status of each workspace you're granted, worst first, so you can see who needs a nudge.

steps.title: Cut off and restore
steps.summary: Nothing cuts off on its own. When a client hasn't paid, you decide, and Restore brings everything back.

steps.title: The change log
steps.summary: Admin, Change log lists every change that affects you and your clients, in date order, so you can see what changed and when.

tracks.label: Super admin
tracks.audience: For Unywebs staff who run billing, trials and the client-site kill switch.

steps.title: Subscriptions
steps.summary: Every workspace on the platform, worst payment status first, with the actions for each.

steps.title: Give a manual trial
steps.summary: Free access until a date you choose, with automatic reminders before it ends.

steps.title: Cut off an account
steps.summary: Pauses the account's automations and every client site linked to it. Always a deliberate, logged decision.

steps.title: systeme.io tags and the audit trail
steps.summary: Check that customers are tagged in systeme.io, re-sync if needed, and see every admin action with its reason.

steps.title: Client sites: the kill switch
steps.summary: Every client app Unywebs builds checks in here. Pause one and its visitors see a neutral page within a minute.

steps.title: Register a site and copy its key
steps.summary: Each app gets its own key, shown once. Put it in the app's hosting and paste the builder prompt into Claude.

steps.title: Pause and restore a site
steps.summary: Type PAUSE to confirm. The owner is emailed, and switching back brings the app back within a minute.

steps.title: The change log
steps.summary: Every change to UnyBase in date order, including internal notes, with who it affects. Search it, filter it, or export it as CSV or JSON.

exempt./: Redirects to the dashboard or the login page.
exempt./guide: The full written guide; the tour links to it.
exempt./guide/demo: Sample screens the screenshots are taken from. Switched off in production.
exempt./dashboard/team: Coming-soon placeholder. Give it a tour step when it ships.
exempt./invite/[token]: Placeholder until the team system ships.
